compose_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to chain input and output symbols
forward_score_graph: compute the forward score of a graph with gtn.forward_score to sum log-space path weights
viterbi_path_graph: find the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
concat_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to chain transducer languages together
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove to eliminate silent arcs
